Bootstrap confidence interval for a distance-decay slope

Source: R/beta-decay-model.R
beta_decay_boot.Rd

beta_decay_boot() estimates the slope of dissimilarity against distance (from beta_decay()) and its bootstrap confidence interval. Because pairs of sites share sites and are not independent, sites, not pairs, are resampled: each replicate draws the sites with replacement and refits the slope on every pair of distinct drawn sites. Compare the slopes of two transects (or taxa) by whether their intervals overlap, or by the interval of their difference (compare).

Usage

beta_decay_boot(
  decay,
  component = c("total", "turnover", "nestedness"),
  nboot = 999,
  conf = 0.95,
  group = NULL,
  per = 1,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

decay

A beta_decay() result.

component

Dissimilarity column: "total" (default), "turnover" or "nestedness".

nboot

Number of bootstrap replicates.

conf

Confidence level.

group

Optional column of decay identifying transects or taxa; slopes are estimated within each, and with exactly two groups their difference is added.

per

Scale the slope to dissimilarity per per distance units (for example 1000 for per km when distance is in metres).

seed

Optional random seed.

Value

A tibble with group (if given), slope, lower, upper, n_sites and nboot; with two groups an extra row difference.

Examples

d <- beta_decay(png_frogs, elevation)
beta_decay_boot(d, nboot = 200, per = 1000, seed = 1)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 5
#>   slope  lower upper n_sites nboot
#>   <dbl>  <dbl> <dbl>   <int> <int>
#> 1 0.154 0.0724 0.468       8   200
